text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Nikkei Shinshun Hai. Faced with the 
first major goal race she had set for 
herself, Meisho Doto became flustered and 
anxious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, to become someone who can support 
TM Opera O, she headed toward the race 
with the cheers of her close friend, 
Matikanefukukitaru, at her back.
